_doc: Snapshot of FRP-4a publisher/deploy/provider/types.go OperatorRecord JSON keys, plus FRP-5 wizard-extras. Drift between this file and either side is a build error.

frp_5_wizard_extras._doc: Fields the wizard adds to the pre-provision record. enabled_families is propagated into ProvisionOpts at FRP-4b binder time; freshness_url is reserved here (empty at V1.5) and populated at FRP-8.

_invariant_25: freshness_url is present and equal to '' at FRP-5; FRP-8 populates.
